simple.meaning: בֹּסֶר (bôçer) is a Hebrew word meaning “sour grape.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֹּסֶר (H1155) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 18:5, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel.
